reviewed_items.source_claim: For a closed immersion i:X↪Y of smooth finite-type k-schemes, with pure dimensions n,m and d=m−n, the conormal sequence 0→I/I²→i*Ω¹_{Y/k}→Ω¹_{X/k}→0 is exact, and its dual is 0→T_X→i*T_Y→N_{X/Y}→0. Étale-locally the embedding is the inverse image of A^n⊂A^m. Blowing up Y×P¹ along X×{∞} is smooth; locally the model blowup is along (f₁,…,f_d,t), with the listed t-chart and f_j-charts affine spaces of dimension m+1, and the actual blowup is obtained by étale flat base change.

reviewed_items.why_warranted: The item joins dual exact sequences, the codimension d=m−n, an étale-local coordinate inclusion, and a blowup with d+1 affine charts. A compact diagram can clarify which maps are dual, how the normal bundle relates to the conormal sheaf, and how the local model lifts to the global blowup. This is an optional editorial aid; all claims and the proof are already stated.
concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Show i:X↪Y and the conormal exact sequence on X: 0→I/I²→i*Ω¹_{Y/k}→Ω¹_{X/k}→0. Under the smoothness and constant-codimension hypotheses, label ranks d,m,n.

Below it, show the dual exact sequence with reversed dual order: 0→T_X→i*T_Y→N_{X/Y}→0, with N_{X/Y}=(I/I²)∨ and ranks n,m,d. Indicate the vertical identifications by duality, not as maps between the original and dual sequences with an assumed canonical direction.
Show the étale-local chart φ:U→A^m with coordinates (f₁,…,f_d,u₁,…,u_n) and X∩U=φ⁻¹(A^n), where A^n is cut out by f₁=…=f_d=0.
For the deformation blowup, show center X×{∞}↪Y×P¹ and its local model center (f₁,…,f_d,t)↪A^m×A¹, where t vanishes at ∞. Indicate the étale flat map ψ=φ×id and the blowup base-change relation.
If the blowup charts are drawn, show one t-chart with coordinates (f₁/t,…,f_d/t,t,u₁,…,u_n) and one chart for each j=1,…,d with (f_j,f_l/f_j for l≠j,t/f_j,u₁,…,u_n). All charts have dimension m+1.
mathematical_checks: The conormal sequence is covariant in the displayed order; dualizing finite locally free terms reverses arrows and yields 0→T_X→i*T_Y→(I/I²)∨→0. Keep N_{X/Y}=(I/I²)∨ and all domain/codomain labels consistent.
The ranks are rank(I/I²)=d, rank(i*Ω¹_Y)=m, rank(Ω¹_X)=n, and d=m−n; the tangent sequence has ranks n,m,d in that order.

In local coordinates the ideal of X is (f₁,…,f_d), the coordinate subspace A^n has equations f_i=0, and u₁,…,u_n are the remaining coordinates. The center of the blowup adds t=0, giving d+1 generators.
The t-chart has ratios f_i/t; an f_j-chart has ratios f_l/f_j for l≠j and t/f_j. Do not interchange the t-chart and f_j-chart coordinates or omit one of the d+1 chart types.

The chart dimension is d+1+n=m+1. The actual blowup is obtained from the model by the étale flat base change ψ; the diagram must not present the blowup itself as globally equal to the affine-space model.
The center is X×{∞}; t is a local parameter vanishing at ∞. On the complement of the center the blowup is the identity. No sign convention or commutative-square error was found.

source_lines.text: Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]) inherited from the
regular-local and smooth differential suppliers. For a closed immersion
$i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ of smooth finite type schemes over a field, with pure
dimensions $n,m$ and constant codimension $d=m-n$, the ideal is locally
generated by a regular sequence of length $d$, $\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$ is
locally free of rank $d$, and
$$0\to\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2\to i^*\Omega^1_{Y/k}\to\Omega^1_{X/k}\to0$$
is exact. Its dual gives $0\to T_X\to i^*T_Y\to N_{X/Y}\to0$. Locally in the
étale topology the embedding is the inverse image of the coordinate inclusion
$\mathbb A^n\subset\mathbb A^m$. Consequently
$\operatorname{Bl}_{X\times\{\infty\}}(Y\times\mathbb P^1)$ is smooth; if $Y$
is quasi-projective, this blowup is quasi-projective. The same immersion and
normal assertions hold on locally closed presentations, by restriction. More
generally, a section $s:T\to P$ of a smooth morphism of locally Noetherian
schemes of constant relative dimension $r$ is a regular immersion of
codimension $r$. Its regular equations and normal bundle commute with every
base change on $T$, including singular bases.

Therefore the conormal sequence is short exact. Dualizing it at each point, the dual of a short exact sequence of finite free modules over a local ring is short exact, so $0\to T_X\to i^*T_Y\to N_{X/Y}\to0$ is exact with $N_{X/Y}=(\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2)^\vee$ locally free of rank $d$.
Form the $k$-morphism $\varphi=(\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_m):U\to\mathbb A^m_k$ with coordinates $\varphi_j=f_j$ for $j\le d$ and $\varphi_{d+j}=u_j$.

Finally, $\varphi^{-1}(\mathbb A^n)\cap U$, where $\mathbb A^n\subset\mathbb A^m$ is the coordinate subspace $t_1=\cdots=t_d=0$, is exactly $U\cap X$, because $X$ is locally defined in $U$ by $f_1=\cdots=f_d=0$ by step 2.1.

Near the centre the coordinate model is the blowup of $\mathbb A^m\times\mathbb A^1$ along $(f_1,\dots,f_d,t)$. Its charts are computed from the Rees algebra: the $t$-chart has coordinates $(f_1/t,\dots,f_d/t,t,u_1,\dots,u_n)$ and the $f_j$-charts have coordinates $(f_j,f_l/f_j\ (l\ne j),t/f_j,u_1,\dots,u_n)$, each an affine space of dimension $m+1$;
By [F9] (flat base change of blowups) the blowup of $U\times\mathbb P^1$ along $X\times\{\infty\}$ is the base change of the smooth model blowup along $\psi$;
